steps.text: the builder makes it switched off, like every flow. In the switch-over sitting (H2), once step 5 of FM VDH Abandoned Cart Router is deleted: remove abandoned_active from everyone who still holds it, since this flow sees only the tag being added (step 5 added it to every abandoner, and Checkout Abandon’s first check would stop them for good); switch this flow on; then the new Checkout Abandon, so it sees every tag that flow adds. Switch the two off and on together: with Checkout Abandon off and people in it, this flow could clear them mid-run. It removes abandoned_active, so the builder needs your permission for that tag here as well as in Checkout Abandon.
at H2’s test abandon, the test contact should also show in this flow, at its 7-day wait: that shows a tag added by another flow starts it.

notes.text: Checkout Abandon · stuck-contact cleanup · email set v57, built from its spec (decision 114). It checks for either tag, since FM VDH Purchase Router removes abandoned_active on any purchase (v52)
